recommendation: Keep the core audit commit as-is. If further action is desired, file or use an Extension Pack issue/PR to decide whether cqf-certainty should adopt current Evidence.certainty changes such as markdown description and repeatable rater.
issue_request: FHIR-28921 is Published/Persuasive for R5 and asks the CDS work group to define a cqf-certainty extension with the same structure as Evidence.certainty, applicable to PlanDefinition, ActivityDefinition, Library, Measure, and cqf-certainty.
initial_application: The issue was initially applied in core by c7b65a0fc7, which added cqf-certainty rows to source/profiles/clinicalreasoning-extensions-spreadsheet.xml and a Clinical Reasoning module link. Later core commits removed extension definitions from the R5 source and rewrote links to the external extension location.
additional_context: The FHIR Extension Pack README identifies it as the maintained home for standard extensions referenced by core. The current Extension Pack source contains StructureDefinition-cqf-certainty.xml and FHIR-50950 later updated its bindings there. Current Evidence.certainty has since changed through FHIR-39572 and FHIR-48987, so cqf-certainty may need Extension Pack review if it is still intended to mirror Evidence.certainty exactly.
reconciliation: Published an empty external-repo audit commit on the combined branch. No core source edit was made because the current core source is not missing an in-scope extension definition; it links to the external definition and retains the OID.
